rules.purpose: Prevent low-confidence or explicitly imagined surface maps from being presented as observed global cartography in the 3D runtime.

haumea.rationale: NASA: elongated body, probably rocky with an icy coating; very little is known about the surface.

makemake.rationale: NASA: surface details are poorly resolved, but global appearance is reddish-brown and methane/ethane ices are detected.

eris.rationale: NASA: very little is known about internal structure; surface is likely rocky and Pluto-like. R03 does not invent a map.
